package.name: chase_flight
package.description:
Real-time flight stack for the vision-based drone chase: the six nodes that put a trained policy on the aircraft (state, policy, depth_rule, behaviour, mixer, safety).
It imports chase_gym for the observation assembler, the forward-speed law and the constants -- the same modules the trainer used -- so the aircraft and the simulator cannot drift apart. torch / onnxruntime are pip dependencies with no rosdep key and are therefore not declared below; onnxruntime is used for inference when an exported actor is present, torch only to read the checkpoint bundle's metadata.
